summary: Frontend regression testing passed for synchronized order expiry, dynamic counts, roles, offers, realtime controls, major routes, and responsive overflow.
action_items: Replace intentionally MOCKED in-memory authentication, order state, offers, realtime controls, and service adapters with production integrations before launch.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js remains a large monolithic module and frontend/src/services/index.js is not consumed; no real persistence, API error handling, or backend integration is covered.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing mock data and temporary in-memory fired orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified selected detail changes to explicit rejected state after 45-second expiry, timer/actions disappear, New tab and sidebar badge reconcile, manual reject, role restrictions, offer preview/create, disconnect/latency controls, all major routes, and no horizontal overflow at 375/768/1024/1440px. Production build also passes.
rca of the issue: Iteration 3 defects were not reproduced. Counts were validated relative to live baseline because the simulator adds an order every 45 seconds; detail assertions were scoped to the selected detail panel to avoid unrelated queue countdowns.
